```{r}
library(rlang)
```


```{r}
y <- 10

f1 <- function(x = {y <- 1; 2}, y = 0) {
  c(x,y)
} 
f1(y = 30)
y
```


```{r}
f1 <- function(x = stop("This is an error!")) {
  stop <- function(...) Sys.time()
  print(x)
}
f1(x = stop("Error!"))
```
- Environments


```{r}
e1 <- env(
  a = FALSE,
  b = 1L,
  c = 2,
  d = "first"
)

env_print(e1)
names(e1)
ls(e1)
formals(ls)

env_print(current_env())
```

- Use `identical()` to check if two environments are the same


```{r}
identical(current_env(), e1)
identical(current_env(), global_env())
f1 <- function() {
  print(identical(current_env(), global_env()))
  print(identical(globalenv(), environment()))
  print(env_parents(current_env() , last = empty_env()))
}
f1()
```
